title: Farewell, Venice
place: Venice, the quay at San Marco, 1271: the Polos leave on a round sailing ship (no rowers).

accuracy.source: Marco Polo, Travels, Yule-Cordier ed. (Project Gutenberg #10636); Claude with ChatGPT (text only), 2026-11-26
findings: Polo does not name the ship; a two-masted lateen round ship (navis), no rowers, fits.
Venice 1271: San Marco and the Campanile stand, but the Doge's palace is the older fortified one (the Gothic palace is c.1340); the Rialto bridge is wooden.

layout.status: Draft blocking for the storyboard (Nov 26 2026); distances are a first proposal.

approved.how: standing approval, 23:25: "can you just not wait for my approval every time, and continue making all the storyboards that we need?"

layout.light: clear morning light from the east (right)

landmarks.label: two-masted round ship at the quay
landmarks.note: a round-hulled two-masted navis with lateen yards and high castles fore and aft, moored along the quay; no oars

landmarks.label: the bell tower of San Marco
landmarks.note: behind the quay to the west

cells.action: Back in Venice, Niccolò and Maffeo show the Khan's gold tablet to young Marco, who stares at it.

where.marco: the young man on the left, leaning in
where.niccolo: the man in the middle holding the tablet

cells.action: The two-masted round ship with lateen sails waits at the crowded quay, the older fortified Doge's palace behind; the three Polos walk toward it, porters carrying chests.

where.niccolo: the figure in red behind him

cells.action: Marco at the ship's rail looks back at Venice, excited and a little afraid.
Niccolò and Maffeo at the rail, calm and resolved, looking ahead to the open sea.

where.niccolo: the older man with the grey beard, left
where.maffeo: the man with the pointed black beard, right
